title: An Almost-Linear Approximation Scheme for Edit Distance

abstractEnglish: We give a uniform randomized approximation scheme for unit-cost edit distance. For every fixed rational $`\varepsilon\in(0,1)`$, it estimates the distance between arbitrary explicitly stored strings of total length N within a factor $`1+\varepsilon`$ with probability at least 2/3, in worst-case expected time $`N^{1+o(1)}`$ on a logarithmic-word RAM. The algorithm supports polynomially bounded integer alphabets and returns zero deterministically on equal strings.

details.overview: 稿件研究单位代价编辑距离的近似计算。摘要声称对每个固定有理数ε∈(0,1)，可在对数词RAM上以最坏情形期望时间N^{1+o(1)}，以至少2/3的概率给出总长N的任意显式存储字符串间距离的1+ε近似。算法支持多项式有界整数字母表，并在字符串相等时确定性返回零。该结果属于字符串算法与细粒度复杂度方向；材料未给出技术细节或实验评估。
keyPoints: 对固定ε给出单位代价编辑距离的1+ε随机近似方案。
最坏情形期望时间为N^{1+o(1)}，成功概率至少2/3。
支持多项式有界整数字母表，相等字符串确定性返回零。
